## Spec

PolicySpec binds client groups to lists and resolver behaviour.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `spec.allowListRefs` | `[]string` |  |
| `spec.allowOnly` | `boolean` | AllowOnly answers only names present in the allow lists. |
| `spec.blockListRefs` | `[]string` |  |
| `spec.blockMode` | `string` | BlockResponse is how a blocked query is answered.<br>One of: `nxdomain`, `zeroIP`, `refused`, `customIP` |
| `spec.blockTTL` | `string` | Default: `10m` |
| `spec.clientGroupRefs` | `[]string` |  |
| `spec.priority` | `integer` | Priority breaks ties when several policies match; highest wins. |
| `spec.queryLog` | `boolean` | QueryLog false excludes matching clients from the query log. |
| `spec.rewrites` | `[]object` |  |
| `spec.rewrites[].cname` | `string` |  |
| `spec.rewrites[].name` | `string` | **Required.** |
| `spec.rewrites[].targets` | `[]string` |  |
| `spec.rewrites[].type` | `string` |  |
| `spec.safeSearch` | `boolean` |  |
| `spec.schedule` | `object` | Schedule limits when a policy applies. |
| `spec.schedule.end` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Pattern: `^([01][0-9]\|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$` |
| `spec.schedule.start` | `string` | **Required.** Start and End are "HH:MM" in TZ.<br>Pattern: `^([01][0-9]\|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$` |
| `spec.schedule.tz` | `string` | Default: `UTC` |
| `spec.schedule.weekdays` | `[]string` |  |
| `spec.upstreamGroup` | `string` |  |

## Status

PolicyStatus is the observed state of a policy.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.conditions` | `[]Condition` | List type: `map`, keyed by `type` |
| `status.observedGeneration` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |

## Example

`config/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_policy.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: kids
  namespace: dns
spec:
  clientGroupRefs: [kids]
  blockListRefs: [default-ads, adult]
  blockMode: zeroIP
  blockTTL: 10m
  schedule:
    weekdays: [mon, tue, wed, thu, fri]
    start: "08:00"
    end: "20:00"
    tz: Europe/Berlin
  priority: 10
```
